title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode3 I'd Like to Go Ask

meta.Episode: Episode3 — I'd Like to Go Ask
meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew. That should be enough for a first draft...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that's left is to see what everyone else thinks and work out any details.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to start thinking about our next song too. Ideally, I'll be able to start working on it as soon as we're finished with this one.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It was only just slightly... But Mafuyu's expression clearly changed that time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still haven't been able to save her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I think I'll find a way as long as I keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And in order to accomplish that, I'll have to start taking different approaches.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Listening to more kinds of songs may be a good place to start...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've been so focused on composing lately that I haven't had a chance to do that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see what's happening online.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... Which genre...? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, this artist posted a new video...?
I thought they retired...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. They decided to come back...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Their new song sounds nice...
I was worried that I'd never be able to listen to their music again after they deleted everything after retiring.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? Their comment keeps going...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's see...
<Breaking news: I will be participating in the next Fan Festival>...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The Fan Festival...?
What's this about...?
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You're going to the Fan Festival?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
Would that be bad?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I didn't say that... It's just... Why?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This artist who went into retirement for a while is going to be there, so I'd like to hear their music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can't you just do that at home? You don't have to go out of your way to do just that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, they deleted all of their videos when they retired and haven't released any CDs or anything, so it's very difficult to find their music.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, interesting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's pretty rare of you to want to go somewhere that's gonna be super crowded, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You like this person's music that much?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I do...
Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought it'd be nice to go out to enjoy music for a change, like we did during the Summer Festival.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, you mean when Akito performed?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, he was pretty good, but it was fun getting to see other artists perform too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Exactly. I liked how the fairgrounds were fully immersed in the sound of music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Immersed in music...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What did you think of that show, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I don't think it was bad...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I just looked up the Fan Festival. It says everything's taking place indoors.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not being outdoors like before will probably make it easier to check everything out, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, much. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to handle an event like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Should be good.
It sounds fun, so why don't we all go?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? All of us...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes, all of us.
Right, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Me too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Actually, sure...!
Kanade wants to go out for a change, so I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Great! That makes me, Kanade, Mizuki and...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're coming too, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What's the point in me going?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What's the point...?
We're gonna go see a show and have fun. What more is there to it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Have fun...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if the last show we saw was fun or not.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, well...
What if you thought about it like this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'll be a nice chance to hear different kinds of music, which might even help you figure out who the “real you” is!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The real me...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! You might not really know it now, but you might feel something again like when you heard Kanade's song the other day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By hearing a bunch of different kinds of music, you might start discovering what you like and dislike, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which might lead to you understanding who you really are!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about it, Mafuyu? Wanna come with us?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mizuki...
Mafuyu isn't gonna just...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! Just like that?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If it means me finding my true self...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! That settles that♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're all going, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I will...
